get_study.description: Get everything ClinicalTrials.gov records about one study from its NCT number: titles, status and dates, sponsor and collaborators, design, groups and treatments, outcome measures, eligibility criteria, contacts, sites (50 unless you ask for more, or only those in one country), publications and whether results are posted, with a link to them. You can paste the study's page address instead of its number.

search_studies.description: Find clinical trials and other studies on ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, treatment, place, sponsor or any words, narrowed by recruitment status, phase, study type, distance from a point, and when studies started, were first posted or were last updated. Each study comes with its NCT number, title, status, phases, conditions, treatments, sponsor, key dates, countries and a short summary. Up to 1,000 a page; pass the next page token for more.
